addFromLink.title: Application from a link
addFromLink.description: The model reads the posting and fills the form in, and ticks any of your own keywords the job is plainly about. The page is kept in the Vault under Job postings, and nothing is saved as an application until you say so.

toast.title: Posting saved and read
toast.kept: {{name}} is in the Vault, and is filed under the application when you save it.
toast.gaps_one: {{count}} field was not on the page.
toast.gaps_other: {{count}} fields were not on the page.

application.noRecord: This sheet was opened without a record to edit

description.edit: Changes replace the current details, and the deadline moves with them.
description.prefilledTagged: Prefilled from what you pasted — check the employer, role and keywords before saving.
description.prefilled: Prefilled from what you pasted — check the employer and role before saving.
description.create: Track a job you are applying for. Starred fields are required.

errors.org: Name the employer — it is what the record is filed under.
errors.role: Name the role, so two applications to the same place stay apart.
errors.roleTag: Pick a role tag — the role filter and the charts read it.
errors.url: That is not a link a browser can open — include https://.

fields.roleTagDescription: The axis the role filter and the charts read.
fields.deadlineHint: Puts a dated entry on the calendar and in the week ahead.
fields.postingIdHint: The job or requisition number, if the posting states one.
fields.notePlaceholder: What still has to happen before this goes out.

toast.nothingAdded: Nothing was added. Undo brings the form back as you left it.
toast.unchanged: {{name}} is unchanged. Undo brings your edits back.
toast.recordUnchanged: The record is unchanged. Undo brings your edits back.
toast.noDeadline: No deadline yet — add one and it shows up in the week ahead.
toast.postingFiled: The posting is filed under it.
toast.deadlineRemoved: {{name}} — its deadline is off the calendar.

duplicate.title: This looks like a job you already have
duplicate.modelSame: The model read them as the same vacancy.
duplicate.modelReading: — the model’s reading; check it below.
duplicate.tapToOpen: Tap to open it, or carry on and add this as a second record.

draft.title: Draft a message

description.forApp: For {{name}}. Nothing is generated and nothing is sent — fill the blanks, copy it into your mail client, then mark it sent.
description.forItem: For {{name}} · {{item}}. Nothing is generated and nothing is sent — fill the blanks, copy it into your mail client, then mark it sent.
description.unlinked: Not linked to an application, so [ROLE] and [DATE] stay blank. Nothing is generated and nothing is sent — fill the blanks, copy it into your mail client, then mark it sent.

draft.openFromReminder: Open this from a reminder to tick it off
draft.startFromSnippet: Start from one of your email snippets
draft.placeholder: Write the message, or pick a snippet to start from…

empty.title: No email snippets yet
empty.description: Snippets tagged Email show up here as starting points. There is nothing to load, but the draft does not have to start from one.

status.nameNever: · a person's name is never filled in for you

picker.title: Start from
picker.description: Your own email snippets, with what the records know already filled in.

stage.nothingElse: Nothing else on the record changed.

submitted.portalHint: Where the application lives, for when you need to chase it.

interview.mintDescription: Creates an interview entry on that date, with a reminder.

offer.mint: Add the deadline to the timeline
offer.mintDescription: A respond-by date with nothing watching it is the one deadline you cannot afford to miss.

keepOffer.label: Keep the offer details
keepOffer.description: Respond by {{date}}. Turn this off to clear them.
keepOffer.descriptionWithComp: Respond by {{date}} · {{comp}}. Turn this off to clear them.

timeline.description: One record either way — it lands on the calendar for the date you give it, and in the Vault's reminders list while the switch is on.

fields.title: Title
fields.remindOn: Listed in the Vault with a tick box, and on the calendar for its date.
fields.remindOff: On the calendar for its date only — no tick box in the Vault.
fields.allDayDescription: Off gives it a start time and a length.
fields.applicationHint: Links them, so each application lists this and this leads back to any of them.
fields.kindFollowUp: A follow-up is also counted as owed on Today, until you tick it off.
fields.kindHint: The icon it carries on the calendar and in the reminders list.
fields.detailHint: One line of context, shown under the title.
fields.noteHint: Your own scribble. Kept apart from the detail, so an edit never clobbers it.
fields.keywordsHint: Shared with applications, files and links — filtering by one finds all of them.

toast.goneFromBoth: Gone from the reminders list and from the calendar.
